- build-iteration-plan: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-iteration-plan/SKILL.md — What to fix before the next round and what to leave, one change per problem, what the next round must show, what cannot be compared, when to stop
- build-demo-script: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-demo-script/SKILL.md — The moment to show first, the path, what users did (counts as run), the limits said out loud, the decision asked, answers for "when can we have it"
- build-production-gap-note: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-production-gap-note/SKILL.md — What it proved against its pass line, what it does not prove, what is faked, the gap as work items with an owning role and no dates
- build-engineering-handover: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-engineering-handover/SKILL.md — How to open and run it, a screen and requirement map, decisions and reasons, everything faked, known problems, keep, rebuild or throw away as a recommendation
- build-review-request: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-review-request/SKILL.md — The one question for an engineer, what you are not asking, a thirty-minute walk-through plan, the three places you suspect, what you will do with the answer
- build-learning-card: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-learning-card/SKILL.md — What we believed, what we observed against the pass line, what we learned, what we still do not know, what we do next
- build-decision-memo: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-decision-memo/SKILL.md — One page: the decision asked, the evidence, the gap to production, three options with their cost as engineering states it, who decides, the date
- build-experiment-design: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-experiment-design/SKILL.md — For the version engineers build: hypothesis, variants, one primary metric, guardrails, a sample and duration check, a decision rule set before launch
- build-routine-skill: packs/product-builders-pack/skills/build-routine-skill/SKILL.md — Your own repeat steps turned into a skill: real trigger phrases, fixed steps, a quality bar with the pre-share checks, a test on three past inputs
- Reference: packs/product-builders-pack/resources/evidence-and-sources.md

## Claude for Product Designers: 32 Claude Skills

Claude for Product Designers: 32 Claude skills for one piece of design work, from the request to the result, in eight stages: frame the problem with a problem framing brief, a user journey map and a HEART metrics plan; explore and decide with design principles, an options trade-off table, a rationale doc and a decision log; design with context through a design system rules file, a product context file, the user flow, the copy deck and every UI state; prototype around one question; critique against a quality bar, ten heuristics and an accessibility review; test with real users; hand off with a spec and a UX debt register; then show the impact in a review deck, a pushback brief, an impact write-up and a portfolio case study. For product designers, UX and UI designers, and designers who do their own research. Claude drafts, checks and explains; you make the design decisions, real users test the work, and nothing is presented as tested, accessible or ready to ship that was not.

- Pack: packs/product-designers-pack/README.md
- pdes-problem-framing-brief: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-problem-framing-brief/SKILL.md — The request as handed over, the problem with no fix in it, evidence and gaps, a "not solving" list, hypotheses placed by risk and value
- pdes-user-journey-map: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-user-journey-map/SKILL.md — One group, one scenario, stages, actions, thoughts, feelings, touchpoints and pain points, every cell tagged to its evidence
- pdes-heart-metrics-plan: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-heart-metrics-plan/SKILL.md — Chosen dimensions, goal, signal and metric for each, baselines or "baseline needed", instrumentation asks, guardrails
- pdes-design-principles: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-principles/SKILL.md — Four to seven stands for this product, what each gives up, "this, not that" pairs, a conflict check
- pdes-design-options-tradeoffs: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-options-tradeoffs/SKILL.md — Two to four options that differ in structure, criteria, consequences in words, what each option gives up
- pdes-design-rationale-doc: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-rationale-doc/SKILL.md — The decision, why each option lost, evidence or visible gaps, trade-offs accepted, risks, the signal that reopens it
- pdes-design-decision-log: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-decision-log/SKILL.md — Numbered decision records with context, status, consequences, decider, revisit trigger and an index
- pdes-design-system-rules-file: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-system-rules-file/SKILL.md — Tokens by name and role, component rules and states, do and do not pairs, a list of what is missing, a five-prompt test
- pdes-product-context-file: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-product-context-file/SKILL.md — One file Claude reads first: users, jobs, voice, principles, constraints, what the product never does, where each fact came from
- pdes-user-flow: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-user-flow/SKILL.md — Entry points, steps with system responses, decision points, error and recovery branches, exits, open questions
- pdes-ux-writing: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-ux-writing/SKILL.md — Every string for one flow in one table, errors that say what to do next, length limits, terms checked, approvals still needed
- pdes-ui-states-and-edge-cases: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-ui-states-and-edge-cases/SKILL.md — Screens against states, an edge-case sweep per screen, each cell marked designed, missing or not needed with the reason
- pdes-prototype-brief: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-prototype-brief/SKILL.md — The one question, the audience, the lowest fidelity that answers it, real and faked parts, the pass line, what it does not prove
- pdes-claude-design-prototype: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-claude-design-prototype/SKILL.md — The written brief for Claude Design, the look specified, three or more directions, what to fix by hand, saved copies, limits to plan around
- pdes-prototype-share-check: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-prototype-share-check/SKILL.md — A list a person runs before sharing: the label, what is faked, invented data only, link access, a contrast and keyboard look, the words to say
- pdes-design-quality-bar: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-quality-bar/SKILL.md — Yes or no checks by stage, a must-pass list proposed for the person who owns quality to confirm
- pdes-design-self-critique: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-self-critique/SKILL.md — Your pass and a second-opinion pass against ten heuristics, merged issues, trade-offs, what needs a real user, the fix list
- pdes-accessibility-review: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-accessibility-review/SKILL.md — Design-stage checks marked pass, fail or cannot tell from a design, the fixes, and what only code, assistive technology and disabled users can show
- pdes-design-sameness-check: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-sameness-check/SKILL.md — An inventory of default choices, each chosen or inherited, three places for a real decision, what stays standard
- pdes-critique-session-brief: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-critique-session-brief/SKILL.md — Numbered objectives, the stage, the one question for the room, out of scope, the walkthrough, a framing sentence
- pdes-critique-notes-to-actions: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-critique-notes-to-actions/SKILL.md — Notes merged and sorted, your call on each, actions with owners and dates, a three-line reply
- pdes-usability-test-plan: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-usability-test-plan/SKILL.md — Goals, task scenarios with the path unstated, success criteria set first, a moderator script, an observer grid, the sample, a pilot
- pdes-accessible-test-sessions: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-accessible-test-sessions/SKILL.md — How to invite disabled and older people, access needs asked in advance, their own technology, accessible consent, session adjustments
- pdes-usability-findings: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-usability-findings/SKILL.md — Task outcomes as "n of N", what people did beside what they said, issues with evidence and a proposed severity, clips to pull
- pdes-design-handoff-spec: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-handoff-spec/SKILL.md — Which version is final, flows, rules next to screens, tokens by name, motion, focus order, copy status, open questions, a ready check
- pdes-design-system-change-record: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-system-change-record/SKILL.md — One proposed change, what exists and why it does not serve, the "build it from what exists" check, who is affected, the decision left blank for the owner
- pdes-ux-debt-register: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-ux-debt-register/SKILL.md — One row per issue as user impact, frequency from evidence, effort set with engineering, value against effort, a short list to propose
- pdes-design-review-deck: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-review-deck/SKILL.md — The decision asked on slide one, options and what the recommendation gives up, real evidence, feedback in scope, next steps
- pdes-stakeholder-feedback-log: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-stakeholder-feedback-log/SKILL.md — Every comment by role and objective, duplicates merged, conflicts side by side for the decider, reply drafts you send
- pdes-design-pushback-brief: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-pushback-brief/SKILL.md — The request and its goal, the risk with evidence, two alternatives, what you will and will not do, who decides
- pdes-design-impact-writeup: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-design-impact-writeup/SKILL.md — What design changed, before and after from your data, what else moved, a confidence level, results that got worse kept in
- pdes-portfolio-case-study: packs/product-designers-pack/skills/pdes-portfolio-case-study/SKILL.md — One project told through three to five decisions, your role, what real users did, real outcomes, a confidentiality check
- Reference: packs/product-designers-pack/resources/evidence-and-sources.md

## Claude Guide for Product Strategy: 32 Claude Skills

Claude Guide for Product Strategy: 32 Claude skills for one product strategy cycle in eight stages: diagnose with the strategic question, a product health read, an issue tree and a hypothesis board; read the market and the customer with competitors, segments by need, an opportunity solution tree and a market size; choose with options that differ in kind, a decision matrix, the bets and the not-doing list; stress-test with scenarios, a red team review and a pre-mortem; put numbers on it with a business case, a north star metric and strategy KPIs; build the Now-Next-Later roadmap and quarterly OKRs; tell it in the strategy document, the one page, the deck and the board memo; then review it each quarter. For product managers and product leaders who own a strategy or a roadmap, and founders and fractional product people who write one for a client. Claude structures the thinking and drafts the documents; a named person makes the choices, and every figure names its source or is marked as an assumption.

- Pack: packs/product-strategy-pack/README.md
- strat-strategic-question: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-strategic-question/SKILL.md — The one strategic question, the decision it feeds with its owner and date, horizon, scope in, out and taken as given, one alternative framing
- strat-product-health-read: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-product-health-read/SKILL.md — Four lenses (usage, quality, revenue signals, feedback), a source and date range per line, tracking changes flagged, what the data cannot tell
- strat-issue-tree: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-issue-tree/SKILL.md — The root question word for word, sub-questions split by one logic per level, overlap and coverage checks, the data that answers each leaf
- strat-hypothesis-board: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-hypothesis-board/SKILL.md — One hypothesis per branch that could be false, kill criteria written before any test, an importance by evidence map, the cheapest test for the top three
- strat-competitive-analysis: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-competitive-analysis/SKILL.md — Landscape by the customer's job with workarounds and doing nothing as rows, a source and read date per cell, win and loss themes from buyers, where we differ, what not to copy
- strat-needs-based-segments: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-needs-based-segments/SKILL.md — Job statements with circumstance and trigger, the current alternative, a size signal from aggregate data, the segment the strategy serves first and the ones it does not
- strat-opportunity-solution-tree: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-opportunity-solution-tree/SKILL.md — One outcome, opportunities that each cite an interview, a target opportunity, three ideas with the riskiest assumption, the slots marked "needs an interview"
- strat-market-sizing: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-market-sizing/SKILL.md — Top-down and bottom-up estimates as low, base and high, every input sourced or labelled assumption, the gap between methods, the share the plan needs
- strat-lean-canvas: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-lean-canvas/SKILL.md — One canvas per segment filled problem first, every entry marked tested or untested, the three riskiest untested assumptions with the cheapest test
- strat-product-vision: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-product-vision/SKILL.md — Vision statement options with what each rules out, target group by need, needs marked confirmed or assumed, product, business goals
- strat-strategic-options: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-strategic-options/SKILL.md — Three to five options that differ in kind, "do nothing" with the cost of waiting, the bet each makes, what each gives up, reversibility
- strat-decision-matrix: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-decision-matrix/SKILL.md — Criteria and weights dated before any score, pass or fail gates, a consequence table per option, scores with evidence, weight sensitivity
- strat-strategic-bets: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-strategic-bets/SKILL.md — Three to five bets written as what would have to be true, the evidence today, the test or early signal, a kill criterion and date, an owner by role
- strat-not-doing-list: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-not-doing-list/SKILL.md — "We will not" lines with the reason, what saying no costs and who hears it, the short answer to give, the condition that would reopen it
- strat-scenario-planning: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-scenario-planning/SKILL.md — Base, upside and downside per option on two or three drivers, every value sourced or marked assumption, the assumption that flips the choice, early signals, as an editable spreadsheet
- strat-red-team-review: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-red-team-review/SKILL.md — The assumptions the plan cannot survive losing, the strongest case against, counter-evidence on file, three sceptic questions, a change-now list, accepted risks
- strat-pre-mortem-analysis: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-pre-mortem-analysis/SKILL.md — Failure defined at a date, failure stories gathered independently and clustered, early signal, prevention, contingency with trigger, owner by role
- strat-recommendation-memo: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-recommendation-memo/SKILL.md — The call and the ask in the first line, three reasons tied to evidence, every rejected option with its fair case, risks, a one-minute answer to "why not the other option?"
- strat-business-case: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-business-case/SKILL.md — One page in five parts, options including do nothing, an assumptions table with low, base, high, source and owner by role, what would change the answer
- strat-north-star-metric: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-north-star-metric/SKILL.md — Candidates tested against customer value, strategy and leading the business result, the exact definition, three to five inputs, a counter-metric per input
- strat-strategy-kpis: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-strategy-kpis/SKILL.md — Per bet, the goal, signal and metric, leading and lagging indicators, baseline with source, a guardrail, the review date and the threshold to change course
- strat-impact-map: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-impact-map/SKILL.md — The goal with its measure, the actors, behaviour changes marked seen or assumed, every roadmap item under an impact or on a cut-or-justify list
- strat-product-roadmap: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-product-roadmap/SKILL.md — Items as problems linked to a strategy action, ordered by cost of delay over duration, placed by horizon with confidence, dated commitments flagged, "not on the roadmap", a one-screen executive cut
- strat-quarterly-okrs: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-quarterly-okrs/SKILL.md — One to three objectives tied to strategy actions, outcome key results with baseline, target and source, a capacity split, a stop list, grading of key results only
- strat-product-strategy-doc: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-product-strategy-doc/SKILL.md — The argument leadership reads and signs, two pages at most: diagnosis with evidence, guiding policy and what it rules out, three to five coherent actions, "we will not" lines, the bets
- strat-one-page-strategy: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-one-page-strategy/SKILL.md — The signed strategy cut to one page for the teams who act on it, with no new content: what it means per team, a say-no test on three real requests, a repeat-from-memory test
- strat-product-strategy-deck: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-product-strategy-deck/SKILL.md — A ghost deck with action titles, presented in a room to win an endorsement: what is against what could be, the obstacle, the approach, the endorsement asked, a source on every claim slide
- strat-roadmap-review-deck: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-roadmap-review-deck/SKILL.md — The ask first, shipped against said from the last review, the horizons by theme with confidence, the costed no list, the one decision needed
- strat-board-memo: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-board-memo/SKILL.md — The product section in one or two pages read ahead: questions for the board first, progress against plan, the few metrics that matter with source, horizons with confidence, risks
- strat-decision-record: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-decision-record/SKILL.md — Status, owner and date, the choice in the owner's words, options rejected, evidence and assumptions known at the time, dissent, review date and reopening triggers
- strat-quarterly-strategy-review: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-quarterly-strategy-review/SKILL.md — Expected against happened, each bet read as holding, weakening or broken against its kill criterion, the cause, a keep, adjust or stop proposal per bet
- strat-strategy-change-note: packs/product-strategy-pack/skills/strat-strategy-change-note/SKILL.md — What changed and what did not, the evidence and the bet that broke, what stops and starts per team, the effect on the roadmap and on dated commitments
- Reference: packs/product-strategy-pack/resources/evidence-and-sources.md

## Claude Guide for Product Interviews: 32 Claude Skills

Claude Guide for Product Interviews: 32 Claude skills for preparing product interviews from the job ad to the offer, in eight stages: read the role with a target role brief, a job ad breakdown and an interview loop map; tell your story with a career evidence inventory, a story bank and resume bullets; prepare the cases for product sense, metrics, prioritisation and execution, and app critique; prepare the conversations with behavioural answers, a portfolio or project walkthrough and a mock interview; show how you work with AI with an AI use plan, a fluency answer and a work sample; get in through people you already know; run each process with a take-home plan, round debriefs and a tracker; then decide with an offer comparison and negotiation prep. For product managers, product owners and product designers with years of shipped work. Claude helps you prepare and practise from work you really did; it never invents a role, a result or a number, and it stays out of the live interview.

- Pack: packs/product-interviews-pack/README.md
- pmjob-target-role-brief: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-target-role-brief/SKILL.md — Two or three target roles with level, your criteria and deal-breakers, the words real ads use, each matched to your evidence
- pmjob-job-ad-breakdown: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-job-ad-breakdown/SKILL.md — One ad read line by line: the problem behind the role, must-haves, level signals, the AI ask, implied rounds, your evidence, gaps
- pmjob-company-research: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-company-research/SKILL.md — What the product does and for whom, your own notes from using it, dated news with sources, three questions a website cannot answer
- pmjob-interviewer-research: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-interviewer-research/SKILL.md — Per interviewer: public professional facts with source and date, likely angle by role, unknowns, one question only they could answer
- pmjob-interview-loop-map: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-interview-loop-map/SKILL.md — Every round with date, length, interviewer, format and what it assesses, the AI rule per stage, stories assigned, questions for the recruiter
- pmjob-experience-inventory: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-experience-inventory/SKILL.md — One evidence row per piece of work, the unglamorous work logged on purpose, strengths backed by two rows, a do-not-claim list
- pmjob-story-bank: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-story-bank/SKILL.md — Eight to twelve stories in a two minute and a thirty second version, tagged by competency, with follow-ups and facts not to stretch
- pmjob-tell-me-about-yourself: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-tell-me-about-yourself/SKILL.md — A ninety second answer in present, past, future order, a twenty second version, two true sentences for "why are you looking"
- pmjob-resume-bullets: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-resume-bullets/SKILL.md — Two to four lines per role as challenge, action, result, with scope, your decision, your part apart from the team's, sourced numbers only
- pmjob-linkedin-profile: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-linkedin-profile/SKILL.md — A section check, three headline options, an About in your own voice, a claim map, mismatches with the resume to fix first
- pmjob-product-sense-case: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-product-sense-case/SKILL.md — A practice case on an open product or design question, then notes on your answer against a rubric you can see
- pmjob-metrics-case: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-metrics-case/SKILL.md — Practice on choosing success metrics and on diagnosing a metric that moved, with your reasoning written out and checked
- pmjob-execution-case: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-execution-case/SKILL.md — Practice on a trade-off question: options, what each costs and who pays, the call, the cut, the risk you accept
- pmjob-app-critique: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-app-critique/SKILL.md — A practice critique of an app you choose: users, how it earns its place, flows walked through, the one change you would argue for
- pmjob-behavioural-answers: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-behavioural-answers/SKILL.md — For one round: the competencies tested, a story and a reserve story for each, the follow-ups and your honest answers
- pmjob-work-walkthrough: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-work-walkthrough/SKILL.md — A timed talk on two or three pieces of work: stakes, your role, three decisions, the mistake, the outcome, a slide outline, likely questions
- pmjob-questions-to-ask: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-questions-to-ask/SKILL.md — Questions for each interviewer by role, website-answerable ones removed, three marked to ask first
- pmjob-mock-interview: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-mock-interview/SKILL.md — A practice round with a stand-in interviewer and follow-ups, then notes on each answer as present, thin or missing
- pmjob-ai-use-plan: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-ai-use-plan/SKILL.md — One page per employer: what they allow at each stage and where it is written, the question for the recruiter, the sentence you will say
- pmjob-ai-fluency-answer: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-ai-fluency-answer/SKILL.md — An answer to "how do you use AI in your work" from two or three real examples, in a short and a long version, with no tool list
- pmjob-ai-work-sample: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-ai-work-sample/SKILL.md — A one page write-up of a real task, an optional small prototype labelled as a prototype, a confidentiality check
- pmjob-target-company-list: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-target-company-list/SKILL.md — Ten to twenty companies with a sourced reason each fits, the open role, who you know there, and a dropped list
- pmjob-reason-to-write: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-reason-to-write/SKILL.md — For each former colleague, one honest reason to get back in touch, what not to ask yet, points for a message you write
- pmjob-informational-questions: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-informational-questions/SKILL.md — Questions for a conversation with an insider, website-answerable ones removed, five to ask first, a closing question
- pmjob-referral-ask: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-referral-ask/SKILL.md — A readiness check on the relationship and the role, a plain "not yet" when it is, points for asking with an easy no
- pmjob-recruiter-screen: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-recruiter-screen/SKILL.md — A check that an inbound message is real, then one page for the first call: why you are looking, timing, pay expectations, your questions
- pmjob-take-home: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-take-home/SKILL.md — The brief restated, questions to send first, a time box you set, the submission structure, an assumptions page, a note on AI use
- pmjob-round-debrief: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-round-debrief/SKILL.md — What was asked, what you answered, promises made, what to change in your stories, points for a specific thank-you
- pmjob-search-tracker: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-search-tracker/SKILL.md — One row per process, a twenty minute weekly review, one nudge for a silent process and then a close
- pmjob-offer-comparison: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-offer-comparison/SKILL.md — Each offer, and staying where you are, against your own criteria and weights, with sources, unknowns and questions before you sign
- pmjob-negotiation-prep: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-negotiation-prep/SKILL.md — Your real alternative, what you want and the least you would accept, the facts behind each ask, the order of the conversation
- pmjob-30-60-90-plan: packs/product-interviews-pack/skills/pmjob-30-60-90-plan/SKILL.md — A first draft for the new role: who to meet, what to learn before changing anything, one early result, what you will propose
- Reference: packs/product-interviews-pack/resources/evidence-and-sources.md
